description: Data-driven contract for per-title Unreal build/layout fact profiles. Rules are generic and live in this schema plus tools/validate_profile.py; per-build VALUES live only in profile files. A profile records only facts traceable to cited evidence artifacts, keeps serialized file-image addresses strictly distinct from any mapped runtime addresses, and never fills gaps with PDB defaults, other-build values or assumptions.

fact_statuses.validated-static: A genuine (non-candidate) resolver endpoint returned status 0 for this fact against the saved serialized image. Still a file-image label only; never a live pointer, callable function or layout proof.
fact_statuses.candidate-only: Only an endpoint explicitly named/labeled 'candidate' produced a value, or corroboration is incomplete. Cannot be treated as validated by any consumer.
fact_statuses.absent: An endpoint ran (non-zero no-match status) and found no value in the saved image. Absence is itself recorded evidence.
fact_statuses.not-surveyed: No endpoint for this fact has been executed against any saved image. No value may be present.
fact_statuses.unresolved: Survey attempted but outcome is not reducible to validated/candidate/absent (e.g. ambiguous or malformed-image statuses). No value may be present.

family_status_aggregation: family_status is recomputed by the validator in strict priority order and must match the declared value: 'validated' if any fact is validated-static; else 'candidate-only' if any fact is candidate-only; else 'absent' if any fact is absent; else 'unresolved' if any fact is unresolved; else 'not-surveyed'.

survey_endpoint_status_codes.0: success (value is an operand-derived serialized file-image label)

address_model.elf_image_vaddr: Link-time virtual address of a symbol/operand within the serialized ELF image (section vaddr / PT_LOAD p_vaddr space). The only address kind the static survey produces.
address_model.file_byte_offset: Byte offset within the saved file. MAY be non-null ONLY when an evidence artifact records the program-header derivation; otherwise must be null.
address_model.mapped_runtime_address: Absolute address in the live process. MUST be null unless a provenance_class 'game-runtime' evidence artifact exists and runtime_validation.validated is true.
address_model.load_base: Live load base of the image. Same gating as mapped_runtime_address.
address_model.rule: A value that is actually a file-image vaddr MUST NOT be recorded in file_byte_offset or mapped_runtime_address. All four fields are stored separately; copying one into another is a validation error.

width_rules.width_16_policy: width_bytes 16 is admitted only for entries that carry an 'alternatives_compiled_bytes' list with at least two distinct entries where width_bytes == max(alternatives) (conservative-maximum policy from ue4ss-native-layout-widths-2).
width_rules.unavailable_encoding: An unavailable accessor entry must have width_bytes null plus a non-empty reason; width 0 is never valid.
width_rules.evidence_scope_statement: Every compiled-port-accessor width fact is a source/accessor contract compiled with the real target SDK; it is NOT proof of the game build's ABI, storage or callable layout.

identity_rules.axes_note: Build axes (non_shipping, stats) must be resolved booleans backed by evidence before any staged numeric layout may be marked ready; unresolved axes are recorded as null with an explicit status string, never defaulted (mirrors NativeLayoutBinding SetResolvedNativeLayoutAxes/PublishStagedNativeLayoutMaps).

readiness_fields.static_layout_ready: bool; true only when every required identity fact and build axis is resolved with evidence.
readiness_fields.runtime_binding_ready: bool; true only when a live mapped owner with image identity, segment correspondence and lifetime is proven. No current profile may set this true.
